sources.originalNotes: Approved source-backed provisional1922-12-30 snapshot. Mixed source dates, claim/occupation distinction and registrations retained in immutable ZIP. Other non-Caspian/Aral/Arctic coastline context is NE5.1.1; not2026 surveyed coast. Selection through1925-05-12 by user instruction; the source remains a1922-12-30 reconstruction. Local Dniester boundary follows the built-in modern watercourse by user approval (2026-10-25); not a surveyed or legally delimited 1922 thalweg. Baseline ZIP hashes remain evidence identifiers, not hashes of this locally adjusted geometry. The approximately 1 km river-to-preserved-coast closure (2.87 CSS pixels at app maximum zoom) is geometric inference, not independently established historical boundary. European exterior revised from user-approved Finland/Estonia/Latvia/Poland reconstruction; existing sea coastline and Dniester retained. Modern river/shared sections preserved; only confirmed Latvia dry-land detail lightly simplified. Original ZIP hashes identify baseline evidence, not this adjusted geometry.

basis: State-level membership of the named island group is supported independently by dated administration evidence. All eighteen approved modern polygons and all their rings are copied exactly, replacing all five legacy polygons. A review window enumerates components and does not establish sovereignty. No visibility, area, proximity, or old-NE correspondence filter removes donor components.
limitations: This does not certify the entire historical USSR reconstruction or runtime.
Original Caspian, Aral, Arctic claim exceptions and mainland coordinates are untouched.
Modern physical coast is reused at display scope; exact coast location in 1922 is not established.
Inherited small-island title caveat remains; state-level membership of the named Kolguyev group is independently supported by documentary administration evidence.
rights: Existing historical source, Natural Earth public-domain and approved modern composite donor attribution retained. No blanket new license asserted.
